title: When Anchors Shift the Target: Advantage-Gated Adaptation for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.23038v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forward-process reinforcement learning adapts diffusion and flow-matching models by re-noising rewarded generations into regression targets. Because negative advantages induce concave updates with unbounded repulsive gradients, existing methods stabilize training using cached predictions from a moving policy copy, yet these anchors also alter what positive feedback teaches the model to fit. We formalize this conflict as anchor coupling: after separating frozen-reference regularizers, affine moving-anchor rules cannot eliminate negative curvature while preserving every positive regression target. We propose Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) to decouple these roles. Positive samples retain standard target fitting, whose self-limiting update vanishes at the observed target independently of the moving anchor. translated_title: 当锚点偏移目标：面向扩散强化学习的优势门控自适应方法
translated_abstract: 前向过程强化学习通过将获得奖励的生成结果重新加噪作为回归目标，来适配扩散模型和流匹配模型。由于负优势会导致具有无界排斥梯度的凹型更新，现有方法利用移动策略副本的缓存预测来稳定训练，然而这些锚点同时也会改变正反馈所引导模型拟合的目标。我们将这一冲突形式化为锚点耦合问题：在分离冻结参考正则化项之后，仿射移动锚点规则无法在保留所有正回归目标的同时消除负曲率。我们提出优势门控自适应（AGA）来解耦这两种角色。正样本保留标准的目标拟合，其自限制更新在观测目标处自然消失，且不受移动锚点的影响；负样本则转而采用凹目标在移动策略预测处的一阶切线，从而保留局部……
tldr: 本文提出优势门控自适应（AGA），通过按优势符号解耦正负样本的角色——正样本保持标准目标拟合、负样本改用凹目标在移动策略预测处的一阶切线——从而解决扩散强化学习中的锚点耦合冲突。
en_tdlr: Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) resolves the anchor coupling conflict in diffusion reinforcement learning by decoupling roles based on advantage sign: positive samples keep standard target fitting while negative samples use the first-order tangent of the concave objective at the moving-policy prediction.
